title: TempShap: When and How Much a Feature Matters in Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.33330v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attribution for a time-series forecaster should answer two questions that a feature-level scalar cannot: when in the input window a feature acts, and how much its influence changes across the forecast horizon. Most existing Shapley explainers treat each feature as one player and therefore collapse both axes. We propose TempShap, a retrospective, loss-based Shapley framework whose players are the individual input cells $(t,i)$. Its attribution tensor yields temporal-localization and horizon-impact profiles. We validate these against planted temporal structures, a tractable exact cell game, and a closed-form attribution oracle for a real linear forecaster. Permutation sharing estimates the cell-level game at localized perturbation cost. Under redundant inputs, one-at-a-time scores under-credit substitutable information, whereas the signed Shapley decomposition preserves total value and yields more reliable held-out deletion rankings under

translated_title: TempShap：特征在时间序列预测中何时起作用以及作用多大
translated_abstract: 时间序列预测器的归因分析应该回答两个特征级别标量无法回答的问题：特征在输入窗口中的何时起作用，以及其影响在预测时域上如何变化。大多数现有的Shapley解释器将每个特征视为单个参与者，因此把这两个维度压缩在了一起。我们提出了TempShap，这是一个回顾性的、基于损失的Shapley框架，其参与者是单个输入单元$(t,i)$。其归因张量能够生成时间定位和时域影响轮廓。我们通过植入的时间结构、一个可求解的精确单元博弈，以及一个针对真实线性预测器的闭式归因预言（oracle）来验证这些结果。置换共享方法以局部扰动成本估计单元级博弈。在冗余输入情况下，一次一个的评分会低估可替代的信息，而带符号的Shapley分解则保持了总价值，并在冗余条件下产生更可靠的留出删除排序。
tldr: TempShap提出了一种以单个输入单元为参与者的回顾性、基于损失的Shapley归因框架，能够同时回答特征在输入窗口中何时起作用以及其影响在预测时域上如何变化这两个问题，并在冗余输入下比传统方法提供更可靠的归因。
en_tdlr: TempShap proposes a retrospective, loss-based Shapley framework with individual input cells as players, answering both when a feature acts within the input window and how much its influence changes across the forecast horizon, yielding more reliable attributions under redundant inputs than traditional feature-level methods.
